name: Fairmont Makati
positioning: City hotel in the center of Makati's business, commercial and entertainment district, with a Fairmont Gold hotel-within-a-hotel level
best_for: Travelers who want a base in the middle of Makati
Guests who like a private club level with lounge access and breakfast

facts.text: Fairmont Makati is located at the center of Makati's financial business, commercial and entertainment district.
The hotel is about a 15-minute drive from Ninoy Aquino International Airport.
The Fairmont Gold Corner Suite includes access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge.
Fairmont Spa offers scrubs, wraps, facials and full-body massages.
The spa is on the fourth floor.
The outdoor swimming pool is on the fourth floor.
The hotel has 8 restaurants and bars.
Indoor parking with valet service is available at the hotel.

highlights.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience with private lounge access, an all-day honor bar, complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes, and a dedicated concierge.
Mirèio Brunch Society is a Sunday brunch of French and continental dishes with free-flowing drinks including mocktails, cocktails and wines.
The Deluxe Corner Room has two walls of windows and views of Makati.
The Deluxe Room Pool View rooms overlook the Fairmont Pool.

considerations.text: No cancellation charge applies only before 6 pm local time, up to one day before arrival.
Fairmont Gold benefits, such as private lounge access and complimentary breakfast, come with an upgrade to Fairmont Gold.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with limited outdoor space.
